package.name: nros_rmw_zenoh
package.description:
The zenoh RMW backend for nano-ros (zenoh-pico on embedded targets).
phase-348 W1: this file exists so the backend is DISCOVERABLE — the `nano_ros_provides` export below is what a source-time scan reads. What the backend actually lowers to (features, cmake target, link libraries, capabilities) is declared in the sibling `nros-rmw.toml` descriptor (RFC-0071), which is read only when this backend is the one selected.
